results.Description: Web users need complete keyboard navigation with visible focus on every operable control
results.Do: Keep tab order aligned with visual order and test every action without a pointer
results.Don't: Keyboard traps or illogical tab order

results.Description: Fixed nav should not obscure content
results.Do: Add padding-top to body equal to nav height
results.Don't: Let nav overlap first section content

results.Description: WCAG 2.2 AAA defines minimum area and contrast for focus indicators
results.Do: Use an indicator at least as large as a 2 CSS px perimeter with 3:1 state contrast
results.Don't: Present this enhanced AAA criterion as an AA requirement or use a thin low-contrast outline
